entry_conditions: drawer_position is strictly above 0.26 m; two-frame causal history remains available across the policy switch; red is being released or settled on its pad; blue is outside or already held; arguments select blue and blue_goal.
exit_conditions: Only the unchanged one-observation expression drawer open AND red on pad AND blue inside ends the task. The auxiliary phase, open gripper and high retreat do not alter success.
overlap_role: Every [600,stop) action is supervised, including 250 actions per trajectory in [600,850) shared with red_transfer. Local labels retain red lowering/release, transit, blue approach/closure and lift as actions, not observation-only context.
successor_readiness: There is no learned successor. Continue nominal insertion/release/retreat, or hand to the destination-frame prior when a stable carried blue approaches the drawer. Framework evaluation alone determines completion.
failure_signatures: Phase cues conflict with geometry; gripper closes without blue/TCP co-motion; local increments drift away from source or destination; IK fails/contacts limits; red leaves pad; drawer closes; or blue contacts lip/wall or misses final bounds.
continuation_guidance: Prefer this policy for uncertain valid handoff timing and small feedback-like corrections. Use the blue-frame policy for large free-source displacement and destination-frame policy for final goal displacement. Abort or replan on suspected drop/collision rather than treating the phase head as recovery logic.
limitations: Increment composition does not plan globally and may accumulate drift over eight executed slots. The phase target is a causal geometry heuristic, not contact truth. Large disturbances and re-grasp/recovery are not demonstrated.
